package: 2026-11-26 multi-hypothesis package (~7.2 h on TPU v5e-8, kernel limit 8 h)
context: Runs 144735/082324/102849 used a model whose mixer outputs never reached the residual stream (revision 2 dropped `x = x + d`; fixed + regression test). Run 102849 also produced NaN grown logits at S2 (cause unlocalized). Every arm now writes S2_diag (per-sublayer magnitudes, first non-finite site, fp32 re-run).
common: All arms: K3_STAGED_RUN=real, gate bypass allowed and recorded (data over stop), checkpoints keep only leaves <= 64 MB, held-out CE logged periodically. Arms are isolated processes: a failed arm is recorded and later arms still run.

hypotheses.H1: The missing mixer residual caused CE(0)=13.7 (> ln V). Expect CE(0) of fix_base far below 13.7, ideally below unigram.
hypotheses.H2: The S2 NaN came from out-of-distribution inputs to duplicated early layers (0*inf in a copy). fix_base S2_diag localizes it; aki (copies = next teacher layers, in-distribution) should be finite if H2 holds.
hypotheses.H3: With mixers restored, a trainable lm_head still helps (fix_lmhead vs fix_base, same steps).
hypotheses.H4: The CKA penalty reduces copy/source redundancy at <= 0.02 nat CE cost (fix_base vs lam0).
hypotheses.H5: Growth beats continuing the 8-layer base for the same number of optimizer steps (fix_base vs control_8L; step-matched, not FLOP-matched).

arms.name: fix_base
arms.note: H1/H2 primary: fixed residual, lm_head frozen, stacking copies of base blocks. First arm also pays venv + teacher fetch (cached for later arms).

arms.name: fix_lmhead
arms.note: H3: as fix_base + lm_head trainable in S1.

arms.name: aki
arms.note: H2: copies take mixers of teacher layers 8-15 (bert2BERT AKI) instead of duplicating base blocks; otherwise as fix_base.

arms.name: lam0
arms.note: H4: as fix_base with the CKA penalty off (CKA still logged).

arms.name: control_8L
arms.note: H5: no growth; the 8-layer base trains for 1200 steps (= S1 300 + S3 900 of fix_base).

arms.name: long
arms.note: Long run (last, so a session limit only truncates it): lm_head trainable, S1 600, S3 up to 6000 steps with a graceful 150-min stage budget.
